method.decode: LibRaw highlight mode 5, exposure restored (headroom above 1)
method.recovery: rational shoulder on the largest camera channel before the DCP: knee, former white
method.zone: LR neutral L* >= 97 (block mean 8x8), scenes with at least 1 % of it
method.metrics: zone L* quantiles 10/50/90 vs LR (mean absolute difference); rest: mean |dL*| vs LR
